'''Arions''' were flying, winged [[Manta ray]]-like creatures that could be found in the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The dangerous creatures had [[Color/Legends|blue]] and gold skin, as well as red eyes.<ref name="SSWROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Unnamed in the game or its manual, the Arion was named in a ''Nintendo Power'' magazine article detailing the ''[[Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]'' video game. It also described it as a "flying manta ray."<ref name="NintendoPower">{{BookCite|container=''Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' - Trust in the Force|title=Nintendo Power|number=Volume 67|date=December 1994|link=https://archive.org/details/NintendoPowerMagazineTheSNESEra/Nintendo%20Power%20028%20%28Sep%201991%29%20Super%20Mario%20World/page/n1/mode/2up}}</ref>
